functions.description: Send link identifier, battle record and link block packets
functions.lever: C89-style bare local declarations at function top: block pointer (gs+0x569c) declared last, flag declared before value with zero-inits in the same order (REGPERM r5/r6/r7 rotation)
functions.notes: Packet layout matches func_ov017_021d15b0 receiver; record packing mirrors func_ov004_02168b44. Double identifier copy comes from an inline by-value getter. Shared src pointer across both send loops gives the mov r6,r7 copy.
